about.title: A meadow, tended by hand
about.body:
Artist Meadow is a curated home for India's artists, calligraphers, mehndi artists, engravers, muralists and more, made for the people planning weddings, events and one-of-a-kind gifts.

Every artist here is personally welcomed in. When you find someone you love, you tell us about your celebration and we make the introduction ourselves. Warm, human, no spam.

It's a small labour of love, made by Gallery of Shreya.

footer.tagline: A meadow of artists for weddings, events & custom work.
footer.credit: Developed & lovingly managed by Gallery of Shreya
